Erling Haaland has added another home to his real estate portfolio, this time a five-bedroom villa in Abu Dhabi, which is connected to Manchester City's global brand. The Norwegian striker's purchase was announced during the launch of the second phase of Manchester City Yas Residences by Ohana on October 12.
 The average price of five-bedroom villas in the development is AED 10.7 million, or about $2.9 million. This figure indicates the property's value, not Haaland's individual purchase price.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The development sits on Yas Canal, next to Yas Island, and is the first residential development branded by Manchester City. It will include over 2,000 homes and will be built and sold in stages until 2029.
 Inside Erling Haaland's New Abu Dhabi Property
 Haaland announced the acquisition in a video message during the second phase of the development's launch. The Manchester City striker revealed that the home was meant for his family and also gave a personal insight into the purchase.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement James Gill - Danehouse / Getty Images
 Haaland said that his father, former Manchester City player Alfie Haaland, had also bought a house in the community, adding that they will be neighbors in Abu Dhabi.
 The residential project aims to incorporate aspects of Manchester City into the daily life of the residents. The facilities planned include football pitches, a Manchester City training academy, fitness and recovery areas, and recreational areas for residents.
 Other facilities will include tennis and basketball courts, cycling and jogging trails, a skate park and a canal-side promenade. The broader development will feature a variety of property types, such as townhouses, duplexes, villas and waterfront homes.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Why Haaland's Latest Property Purchase Stands Out
 The investment brings Haaland's portfolio of international properties to a new level. The 26-year-old striker has had links with houses in England, Norway and Spain, and has lived in several countries throughout his career.
 His new acquisition also adds to his Manchester City ties outside the pitch. The development in Abu Dhabi is not being constructed around the luxury home, but rather around the brand, sports and lifestyle facilities of the club.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The project is still under construction, so Haaland's new home is a long-term property investment. The forward and his family will have to wait for the development to move forward before the residence is ready for them to move in, as the developer plans to complete the community in phases by 2029.
